messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@altai.ai>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AltAI seller intake — quick intake + PO question

Hi Rishi / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — excited to get AltAI listed in the Redwood marketplace path. A couple of asks from our procurement / finance team as we start paperwork: 

- Is there a preferred Redwood PO template for marketplace transactions? Our finance team prefers to generate a PO that references the marketplace listing/offer id rather than the standard master contract.
- We also need to understand how reimbursements/billing show up in AWS/GCP invoices when using Redwood as the seller cross-listing partner. Will PO routing be through Redwood finance, or directly through AWS Marketplace?

I've attached our seller packet (v1) so you can see the entity details and W9. Happy to jump on a short call to walk through.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Partnerships, AltAI
maya.patel@altai.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: altai_seller_packet_v1.pdf (12 pages, entity docs)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@altai.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AltAI seller intake — quick intake + PO question

Thanks Maya — appreciate the packet. Looping in Kimberly from Marketplace Ops and Vanessa (channel) to handle the PO and billing mapping. Quick answers up front: 

- Redwood has a marketplace PO template we prefer for third-party listings; attaching a working PO template for AltAI to populate. The template includes an "Offer ID" field so finance can reconcile against marketplace invoices.
- For AWS Marketplace listings, billing typically flows through AWS invoicing when customers buy via marketplace. However, if a customer purchases through Redwood Dedicated routing (direct contract), Redwood Finance will provide an invoice and a PO number to reconcile. We'll map the preferred flow on a case-by-case basis.

Action items:
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether AltAI should expect to see customer POs routed to Redwood finance or to AWS directly for a standard SaaS listing?
- Maya: please fill the PO template and return; if AltAI wants Redwood to be the invoice recipient for initial customers we can coordinate a billing override for the first 90 days to ease reconciliation.

Short call suggestion: 30 minutes to align on PO routing and sample invoice view next Wed. Does 10am PT work?

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@altai.ai>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AltAI seller intake — quick intake + PO question

Hi team —

Confirming process from Marketplace Ops side (short version):

- Standard AWS SaaS listings: customer purchases are invoiced via AWS (marketplace billing). The seller receives payout reports from AWS; seller and customer reconcile separately.
- If the customer requires Redwood invoicing (because they want to route PO to Redwood), we support a "managed purchase" path where Redwood issues an invoice and collects payment, then remits to the seller on the agreed cadence. This requires a signed Redwood Marketplace Intermediary Agreement and a short billing onboarding (KYC/ACH).

Checklist items for AltAI to complete:
- Completed PO_template_CloudMarketplaces.docx (we use this to capture preferred PO fields).
- Completed seller W9/W8 and bank ACH form (we have the bank form in the seller packet)
- Signed Intermediary Agreement if AltAI wants Redwood to be invoice recipient

I've attached the marketplace checklist (aws_listing_checklist.xlsx) and a draft PO template. Mateo, can you confirm how long the billing override (i.e., Redwood as invoice recipient) usually takes to enable after the Intermediary Agreement is signed?

Thanks,
Kimberly
Marketplace Operations Lead

Attachments: PO_template_CloudMarketplaces.docx; aws_listing_checklist.xlsx

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@altai.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AltAI seller intake — quick intake + PO question

Kimberly + team —

If AltAI elects the Redwood-managed invoicing path, the typical lead time is:
- 5 business days to validate seller KYC + ACH details
- 3 business days to finalize the Intermediary Agreement (we have a standard template)
- 2 business days to enable billing override in our marketplace dashboard and test a sample invoice

Total typical SLA: ~10 business days from completed paperwork. For initial customers we can short-circuit to 3-5 business days if AltAI provides completed bank form and signed intermediary NDA.

Maya — if you can return the populated PO template and signed bank form by EOD Monday (6/4), we can aim for a June 15 soft go-live for the billing path for the first pilot customer.

Cheers,
Mateo
Product Ops — Marketplace Finance
